pairs.english: His job was recording each step and comparing widths; pushing and receiving belonged to workers whose shift pay was clear. No one rode in the cargo carriage.

pairs.english: The carriage settled on the receiving trolley and its side door opened. Xiarong first checked the stop beneath the cradle, then exchanged signals with the gap-toothed porter.

pairs.english: After laying the short unloading rails, one pushed and the other steadied, moving the crate and its cradle slowly forward.

pairs.english: At the joint, the pusher paused. Nothing was jammed; Xiarong could no longer see his hand.

pairs.english: The gap-toothed porter moved where he could see her, signaled again, and only then did they push the crate together onto the sorting rack.

pairs.english: The gap-toothed porter put away his tally but still asked about afterward. Director Dong said it needed discussion back there. He did not take up the claim about more carriages, only said today's work should be settled today.
